improvements: Audited root project specification, dependencies, package config, and operational protocol.

problems: Missing audio modality constraint (max_duration_seconds, sample_rate) and result metric properties
improvements: Added max_duration_seconds and sample_rate to constraints schema; added duration_seconds and sample_rate to result metrics schema
verification: JSON schema syntax validation via python json.load

problems: Target engines enum omitted godot; ir_version was locked strictly to 0.1.0
improvements: Expanded target_engines and native_escape_hatches enum to include godot; allowed ir_version 1.0.0

problems: status enum omitted candidate evaluation outcomes (FAIL_NO_PATCHES_APPLIED, INVOCATION_TIMEOUT, etc.); environment omitted hardware property; logs omitted eval_log_dir
improvements: Expanded status enum with full evaluation failure taxonomy; added hardware object to environment schema; added eval_log_dir to logs schema

problems: Schema omitted top-level evaluation fields (total_frames_inspected, artifacts_detected_count, visual_review_pass, frame_observations); temporal_frames omitted confidence score

problems: target_engine enum was restricted to unreal and unity only

problems: evidence_files items strictly required objects, causing schema rejection for path string evidence lists

problems: failure_class enum lacked MSVC specific categories (CONST_QUALIFIER_MISMATCH, MEMBER_VARIABLE_SHADOWED, UNRESOLVED_EXTERNAL_SYMBOL); tool_name omitted rollback and create_checkpoint; diagnostics omitted error_snippet

problems: engine.name omitted godot and agnostic; network_access omitted offline and none; allowed_use_review_status omitted verified
improvements: Added godot and agnostic to engine.name enum; added offline and none to network_access enum; added verified to allowed_use_review_status enum

problems: training_method enum lacked modern alignment methods (dpo, orpo, full); hyperparameters omitted warmup_ratio, weight_decay, logging_steps
improvements: Added dpo, orpo, and full to training_method enum; added warmup_ratio, weight_decay, and logging_steps to hyperparameters

problems: sample_id regex pattern rejected standard prefixes (sft, eval, train, val); schema_version strictly demanded v1.0.0 omitting 1.0.0
improvements: Added sft, eval, train, and val prefixes to sample_id pattern; allowed 1.0.0 alongside v1.0.0 in schema_version enum
